shortDescription: The Nikkei 225 Index gained 130 points or 0.20 percent on Tuesday to close at 63623 points.Gains were led by Softbank (7.95%), Taiyo Yuden (4.82%) and Lasertec Corp (4.29%).Biggest losers were Furukawa Electric (-3.49%), Resona Holdings (-3.10%) and Nitori Holdings (-3.01%).
